career_overview.short_description: Design clear, consistent screens and interface components. Practise visual hierarchy, responsive layouts and accessible interaction states.
responsibilities: Assess goals and constraints relevant to ui designer work
Apply appropriate tools and methods to a bounded task
representative_work: A small component library and annotated multi-screen prototype.

roadmap.title: UI Designer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor and browser. Most tasks use free software or simulation; specialist equipment, accounts and costs are flagged for review when applicable.
roadmap.final_outcome: A small component library and annotated multi-screen prototype.
